column1: # components every module gets (lib/components.sh); a module row of the same kind and name replaces
# one, and ~/.config/fzx/modules/<m>/components.tsv can switch one off ("action  copy  =  =  off"): out of the help
# and the actions menu, while ctrl-y and alt-y still copy in a session (docs/design.md, Actions).
action   copy       ctrl-y  copy the selection to the clipboard  silent,builtin
action   copy-line  alt-y  copy the whole lines                  silent,builtin
action   view       -    view the preview in a pager          foreground,builtin
